invariants.rationale: config is passed in as a parameter and is expected to be used immediately.
context is passed as a parameter and is used in method calls immediately.
context.getStorageConf() is called, so it must not be null.
config.getBasePath() is passed to setBasePath, so it must not be null.
config.getConsistencyGuardConfig() is passed to setConsistencyGuardConfig, so it must not be null.
